title: ClickHouse sync fails on hosts rejecting ArrowStream (Tinybird, no-Arrow builds)
answers: ClickHouse sync fails with invalid format ArrowStream
Tinybird ClickHouse source sync fails but schema discovery works
UNKNOWN_FORMAT ArrowStream error in warehouse source sync
body:
Symptom: Sync from a ClickHouse-compatible host (Tinybird 403 `invalid format ArrowStream`, or a build without Arrow: `UNKNOWN_FORMAT`) fails every run while table discovery succeeds.
Root cause: clickhouse.py:get_rows asked for ArrowStream via `query_arrow_stream`, while metadata queries use Native format, so only extraction broke.
Fix pattern: `_stream_record_batches` catches `ClickHouseError`, matches the message with `_is_arrow_format_rejected` (substring "format ArrowStream"), then re-runs the same query with `query_column_block_stream` and converts each Native block to a `pa.RecordBatch` against the schema from `column.to_arrow_field()`.
Constraints: Only fall back on the format-rejection message; other errors must re-raise (the server rejects before sending rows, so no duplicate data). Arrow stays first choice because Native is ~5x slower. Large-result limits on hosts like Tinybird are not handled (would need paged queries).
